audio_caption: The clip begins with an enthusiastic female speaker introducing herself and her channel and the topic of the video: a "ghost or spirit transition" tutorial for TikTok. She encourages listeners to subscribe to her channel and to check out her social media and new merch. She then announces the start of the tutorial. Background music plays, featuring an upbeat, pop-style tune with synthetic instruments. Then, a snippet of a female voice singing a soulful line, accompanied by a piano melody, emerges as a short musical interlude.

The clip starts with a female speaker explaining that you first have to "find a sound on TikTok and record your video." She tells the listener to record their video on their phone's camera rather than on TikTok. She informs the audience that she recorded her video on her phone and recreates the video she showed them at the beginning, and ends by saying "let's see how this video looks without it being edited." The female speaker continues that it's "one whole video but I'm gonna have to make it into two videos." Then there is a click sound.

The audio clip starts with a female speaker who mentions playing and showing how something looks. She explains that there is a screen, and then they go down, staying down until the end of a sound. She advises viewers to use another device to play the sound while recording their video. Continuing, the female speaker reiterates staying down until the end of the sound and then getting up for the second video.

The audio clip begins with a female speaker explaining that she will be making a video into two videos. She then goes on to say that she will cut her sound and her video, and says, "Save as new".  She mentions that they will still need that video to make a second video. There is another edit being made and the female speaker says, "trim original". The speaker then states that she has to cut and trim one more video. She ends by saying, "save as new clip".

The audio clip starts with a female speaker stating that she's going to go to the app and edit videos. She specifies the videos she'll need, one where she was "lying down" and another where she was "going up." She then states she's going to make the latter a "slow-mo video." Following that, the speaker says "Just like that" and "I'm going to press on done."

The clip begins with a female speaker describing her video editing process, mentioning "those two videos" and the Video Star app, with an enthusiastic tone. She outlines steps such as pressing "+" and "edit video" before selecting a specific video. Continuing in a clear and instructional tone, she says, "make video." The female speaker then discusses importing another video, indicating the process of going up, maintaining a clear and informative tone throughout.

The clip starts with a female speaker providing instructions to the audience, referring to the process of mixing clips. She expresses uncertainty, followed by a more assured tone as she details the video selection steps.  She then says "this video as well".

A female speaker explains how to edit video clips. She mentions seeing a ghost in a video and increasing the intensity of either video. She explains that if she wants the ghost transition more visible or the ghost more visible, she would do something, but she doesn't. She switches to another option and then says she's going to press mix clips, and create mix clips.

The audio clip starts with a person speaking, giving a tutorial and explaining that they "don't want to have like two ghosts". They proceed to describe how they will use a multi-layer clip feature, that requires payment, to fix the problem. There is a casual and instructional tone in their speech. The person outlines picking a video for each layer and then using a mask to erase part of one. Their speech shifts to explaining smoothing out harsh lines. The clip features a single speaker who sounds like a woman.

A single female speaker discusses video editing, specifically about having the “ghost transition thing.” She describes pressing on “create” and “yes,” and then exiting to “send to camera roll,” using a casual and conversational tone.

The audio clip begins with a single female speaker explaining that she will be putting two videos together and will be editing on TikTok. She then elaborates on the process, mentioning selecting the videos and trimming them. Next, she mentions wanting to cut down the first video to where she is going down, then trimming the beginning of the second video to the part where she starts going up. Then she states that she is pressing the checkmark.

The audio clip begins with a cheerful female speaker stating, "And now guys, you can see that I have the two videos trimmed on TikTok." She explains the next steps involving adding sound to the video, mentioning she will "press on next" and "pick the sound that I chose." Light electronic music then begins playing. The female speaker continues to describe the tutorial, explaining, "This is how you guys can make your ghost lunch spear transition." A "whoosh" sound effect is briefly added over the music, followed by the female speaker instructing, "Now let's see the finished video."

The audio begins with a female speaker expressing her hope that viewers enjoyed her video. She encourages them to like and share, and gives a post notification shout-out to a person named Cindy, thanking her for turning on the notification bell and commenting. She concludes her message with appreciation to her viewers. The audio ends with a musical sting, possibly from an outro, featuring an electronic instrument and with a brief tone.
